title: The project that changed overnight
intro: A deadline, incomplete evidence and a team waiting for a decision. Follow the consequences through three decisions and a final commitment.

nodes.title: The situation
nodes.body: It is Monday. Your team has four days to deliver a learning prototype. A key source has changed and your first design may no longer fit.

nodes.title: Choose your first move
nodes.body: What do you do before the team starts building?

choices.label: Keep building from the old brief

nodes.title: What happens next / decision 1
nodes.body: You uncover a requirement that the old brief missed. The team has less building time, but a clearer target.

nodes.title: What happens next / decision 1
nodes.body: The first screen looks polished. A reviewer then points out that it solves yesterday's problem. Rework is now part of the plan.

nodes.title: Pause and reflect / 1
nodes.body: Notice what your decision made possible and what it left unresolved.
nodes.prompt: Why did you choose this route?

nodes.title: Set the scope
nodes.body: You cannot complete every feature by Friday. What will you protect?

nodes.title: What happens next / decision 2
nodes.body: You choose a smaller end-to-end experience with a clear outcome. Several attractive extras move to a later release.

nodes.title: What happens next / decision 2
nodes.body: The breadth makes the concept easy to discuss, but several routes stop at placeholders. You must explain that limit in the review.

nodes.title: Pause and reflect / 2
nodes.body: Notice what your decision made possible and what it left unresolved.
nodes.prompt: Why did you choose this route?

nodes.title: Respond to the trial
nodes.body: Two learners misunderstand the instruction. The stakeholder wants more decoration. What comes first?

nodes.title: What happens next / decision 3
nodes.body: A quick trial shows that learners can now start independently. You record the visual request for the next iteration.

nodes.title: What happens next / decision 3
nodes.body: The stakeholder likes the new look. The instruction is still unclear, so the team must explicitly flag that learning risk.

nodes.title: Pause and reflect / 3
nodes.body: Notice what your decision made possible and what it left unresolved.
nodes.prompt: Why did you choose this route?

nodes.title: Your route, your explanation
nodes.body: Your route is ready to discuss. Compare the consequences of your decisions: evidence, scope and learning clarity. This scenario records a route, not a right-answer score.
nodes.prompt: What would you keep or change next time?
